item.title: Utawarerumono: Shiro e no Michishirube confirmed for PS5, Switch 2, and PC
item.description: Utawarerumono: Shiro e no Michishirube will be available for PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC via Steam when it launches in 2026 in Japan, developer AQUAPLUS announced.

item.title: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten coming to Switch 2
item.description: AQUAPLUS will release a Switch version of Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten day and date with the release of Utawarerumono: Shiro e no Michishirube, which will be available for PlayStaâ¦

item.title: My Hero Academia: All’s Justice ‘We Are Here’ trailer
item.description: Publisher Bandai Namco and developer Byking have released a new trailer for My Hero Academia: All’s Justice dubbed “We Are Here.”

item.title: FEROCIOUS launches December 4
item.description: Dinosaur first-person shooter FEROCIOUS will launch for PC via Steam on December 4, publisher tinyBuild and developer OMYOG announced.

item.title: Palworld ‘Home Sweet Home’ update launches December 17
item.description: Pocketpair will release the “Home Sweet Home” update for monster-catching open-world survival crafting game Palworld on December 17, the developer announced.

item.title: The Coin Game launches in early 2026 for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC
item.description: Open-world arcade adventure game The Coin Game will leave Early Access and launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and PC via Steam in early 2026, publisher Kwalee and developer devotid announced.

item.title: GRIME II demo now available
item.description: A demo for Metroidvania / action adventure game sequel GRIME II is now available for PC via Steam, publisher Kwalee and developer Clover Bite announced.

item.title: Co-op dark fantasy looter shooter Vision Quench announced for PC
item.description: Pocketpair Publishing and developer WizMUD Games have announced co-op dark fantasy looter shooter Vision Quench for PC (Steam). It will launch in 2026.

item.title: Escape from Ever After launches January 23, 2026
item.description: Escape from Ever After will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Switch, and PC via Steam on January 23, 2026, publisher HypeTrain Digital and developer Sleepy Castle Stuâ¦

item.title: This Week’s Japanese Game Releases: Karous, Ripple Island: Kyle and Cal’s Restaurant, more
item.description: Karous for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Switch, and Ripple Island: Kyle and Cal’s Restaurant for Switch 2 and PC are the highlights of this week’s Japanese video game releases.
